tasks.spec:
You are revising v62 of the MK2 Optical Bland SMS pathway one more time, per Ankit's decision: the come-back mechanism must use the gateway's EXISTING /appt-list endpoint — no new gateway fields of any kind. Work only in your current working directory. ./source is read-only reference: the current v62r1 artifacts (build_v62.py, v62_graph.json, scenarios.py, check_candidate_gate.py, redproof_run.py, report.md) plus v61_graph.json and SPEC-v62.md (read item 6 — it specifies this revision exactly). Never modify ./source. No skills, MCP/Apps, network calls, or git commits.

START by copying every ./source artifact except v61_graph.json and SPEC-v62.md into your working directory root, then apply ONLY this revision. Everything else stays byte-identical.

THE MEASURED ENDPOINT (from the gateway's own test suite; do not invent beyond it): `POST /appt-list` accepts JSON `{"patient_id": ..., "store": ...}` with the same Authorization header pattern the other webhooks use, and returns `{"ok": ..., "result": {"count": <int>, "appointments": [...]}}`. Optional filters from/to/include_past exist; send NONE of them — the default window is what we want and probe P4 verifies it.

THE REVISION:
1. REMOVE the invented mechanism entirely: n_identity's `booked_already` responseData mapping, its `booked_already == true` responsePathway and edge, and every `upcoming_appointment` / `booked_already` reference anywhere in builder, graph, scenarios, gate, redproof, and report. n_identity's responseData returns to exactly its v61 set (ok, count, patient_first, patient_id, exam_type_id).
2. ADD a silent Webhook node `n_appt_check` (name it like the other silent nodes, e.g. 'Upcoming appointment check (silent)'): url `https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com/appt-list`, POST, body `{"patient_id": "{{patient_id}}", "store": "{{store}}"}`, same Content-Type and Authorization headers as n_identity, modelOptions retryAttempts 0 and skipUserResponse true. responseData: `ok <- $.ok`, `appt_count <- $.result.count`. responsePathways IN THIS ORDER: ["appt_count", ">=", "1", -> e_defer], ["appt_count", "==", "0", -> n_ask], ["ok", "!=", "true", -> n_ask] — a booked patient defers before anything else; a zero-count or gateway outage falls through to the normal recall opener (never block the campaign on this side-check). Add the matching edges.
3. RETARGET n_identity's ["count", "==", "1"] route (and edge) from n_ask to n_appt_check. All other n_identity routes unchanged.
4. Update the gate's G5 to enforce the new shape: n_identity count==1 -> n_appt_check; n_appt_check exists as a silent Webhook on /appt-list mapping appt_count from $.result.count; its appt_count >= 1 -> e_defer route ordered before any n_ask route; a fallthrough to n_ask exists; zero occurrences of upcoming_appointment/booked_already/campaign_booked in the graph. Keep every other gate rule at full strength.
5. Update redproof's M6-class mutations for the new shape: delete n_appt_check; reorder its defer route after n_ask; retarget count==1 straight to n_ask; remove the appt_count mapping. Each must make the gate fail. Keep all other mutations; mutations_caught must stay >= 15.
6. Update the re-entry scenarios to describe the /appt-list mechanism (booked re-entry: appt_count >= 1 -> e_defer; unbooked re-entry: appt_count == 0 -> n_ask -> normal booking) and the report's come-back section: zero gateway changes needed, endpoint already tested in gw-diag-snap, probe P4 now verifies the /appt-list default window excludes past appointments and count flips to >= 1 after /sign.

AFTER EDITING: regenerate v62_graph.json via `python3 build_v62.py`; run `python3 check_candidate_gate.py v62_graph.json` (pass), the gate against a copy of source/v61_graph.json (must fail), and `python3 redproof_run.py` (exit 0, mutations_caught >= 15). Record the executions in report.md.

HONESTY RULES: touch nothing outside this revision; derive the webhook's header/auth shape from n_identity in the existing builder, not from imagination; if anything cannot be carried over byte-identical, flag it prominently in report.md.
tasks.verified: All prior assertions hold, plus: n_appt_check silent webhook on /appt-list with appt_count from $.result.count, defer-before-ask ordering, identity count==1 chains through it, and zero references to the retired campaign_booked/upcoming_appointment/booked_already mechanisms.
